methods.label: Slope ratio and tangent
methods.explanation: The slope ratio equals the tangent of the angle of slope: \(\tan\alpha=1/\sqrt{3}=\sqrt{3}/3\), so \(\alpha=30^\circ\).
methods.levelReason: The slope definition and special-angle tangent value are within Grade 9 scope.
